matching: Items 1-2 gap-fill naming an object from its use; 3-4 choice of object in context; EC = article_indef_omission before a singular classroom noun (Arabic has no indefinite article); FP = one sentence naming an object on your desk/in your bag; transfer = a teacher's list instruction. Review round 1: slots 5-6 are now wrong-object errors (wrong classroom noun for its use), not article omission.
